### This script checks migratory status is defined by the number of month present throughout the year
### Species richness counts per ecoregion, status group, season and monthly presence are also conducted



```{r}
#Load packages

library(tidyr)
library(testthat)
library(xtable)

```


## Loading data-----------
```{r}
#load monthly presence data
pools<- readRDS(paste0(out_dir, "seasonal_ecoregion_pools_aoh.rds"))
```


 # --------------------species richness and migratory status checks---------------------

```{r}

# yearly presence checks---------

# check that residents are present in all months and migrants are present only in some months for each ecoregion
# change to expect false

test_that("migrants and residents are as defined", {
  expect_true(all(pools$n_month_year[pools$status == "migrant"] < 12)) #no migrants should be present year round
  expect_true(all(pools$n_month_year[pools$status == "resident"] == 12)) #no residents should be absent in any months
})


#seasonal presence checks---------

#get max months of each season
seasonal <- pools %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  mutate(max_months = max(n_month_season)) %>%
  ungroup()


test_that("migrants and residents are as defined seasonally", {
  migrant_full <- seasonal %>%
    filter(status == "migrant") %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    summarise(all_full = all(n_month_season == max_months))
  expect_false(any(migrant_full$all_full)) #no migrants should be present in all months of all season

#all residents should be present in all months of all seasons
  residents <- filter(seasonal, status == "resident")
  expect_true(all(residents$n_month_season == residents$max_months))
})


# species richness checks for yearly monthly migrant analysis-------------

# number of migrants and residents overall
status_counts <- pools %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  distinct(species) %>%
  count() # 160 migrants, 78 residents

#xtables------ 

#need \usepackage{graphicx} and \usepackage{booktabs}

# number of species per ecoregion and migratory status groups for yearly analysis

n_species_status_ecoregion <- pools %>%
  distinct(ecoregion, species, status) %>%
  group_by(ecoregion) %>%
  summarise(
    all_species = n_distinct(species),
    migrant_species = sum(status == "migrant", na.rm = TRUE),
    resident_species = sum(status == "resident", na.rm = TRUE))

  #print(xtable(n_species_region)
n_species_status_ecoregion_tab <- xtable(n_species_status_ecoregion, caption = "Species Richness By Ecoregion and Migratory Status", label = "tab:sr_checks_binary_yearly", digits = 0)

#or xtable(species ~ ecoregion + status, data = pools)

print(n_species_status_ecoregion_tab, include.rownames = FALSE, booktabs = TRUE, file = "Manuscript/Tables/species_richness_checks_by_ecoregion_status.tex") #updates when re-run and outputs latex for use in report

# Caledon conifer forests              141
# Celtic broadleaf forests             191
# English Lowlands beech forests       157
# European Atlantic mixed forests      86
# North Atlantic moist mixed forests   149


# number of species in each ecoregion, season and migratory status group for seasonal analysis----

n_species_status_season_ecoregion <- pools %>%
  filter(n_month_season > 0) %>%
  distinct(ecoregion, season, species, status) %>%
  group_by(ecoregion, season) %>%
  summarise(
    all_species = n_distinct(species),
    migrant_species = sum(status == "migrant", na.rm = TRUE),
    resident_species = sum(status == "resident", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")


n_species_status_season_ecoregion_tab <- xtable(n_species_status_season_ecoregion, caption = "Species Richness By Ecoregion, Season and Migratory Status", label = "tab:sr_checks_binary_seasonally", digits = 0)

print(n_species_status_season_ecoregion_tab , include.rownames = FALSE, booktabs = TRUE, file = "Manuscript/Tables/species_richness_checks_by_ecoregion_status_season.tex") #updates when re-run and outputs latex for use in report, need to input/

#or xtable(species ~ ecoregion + season + status, data = pools)

# species richness checks for monthly migrant analysis yearly--------------
n_species_monthly_status_ecoregion <- pools %>%
  distinct(ecoregion, species, n_month_year) %>%
  count(ecoregion, n_month_year) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = n_month_year, values_from = n, values_fill = 0, 
  names_sort = TRUE, names_prefix = "migrant ") %>%
  rename(resident = `migrant 12`) #rename species present all year to residents

n_species_monthly_status_ecoregion_tab <- xtable(n_species_monthly_status_ecoregion, caption = "Species Richness By Ecoregion and Monthly Migratory Status", label = "tab:sr_checks_month_migrant_defintion_yearly", digits = 0)

print(n_species_monthly_status_ecoregion_tab, include.rownames = FALSE, booktabs = TRUE, scalebox =0.7, file = "Manuscript/Tables/species_richness_checks_by_ecoregion_monthly_status.tex")

# species richness checks for monthly migrant analysis seasonally--------------

_species_monthly_status_ecoregion_season <- pools %>%
  filter(n_month_season > 0) %>% #filter to only seasons where species are present 
  distinct(ecoregion, season, species, status, n_month_season) %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(status == "resident", "resident", paste("migrant", n_month_season))) %>% #resident status assigned from status as confirmed this aligns with monthly presence in above unit testing checks, actually wouldnt work as migrants would be labelled seperately- will need to think about this as do i want to compare migrants present in all months of a season to residents?- i.e. do i want to know if migrants contribute unique functions even if they are present for the full duration of the season the answer is probably yes!
  count(ecoregion, season, group) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0, names_sort = TRUE) 

 
#convert to x table for latex report
n_species_monthly_status_ecoregion_season_tab <- xtable(n_species_monthly_status_ecoregion_season, caption = "Species Richness By Ecoregion and Seasonal Monthly Migratory Status", label = "tab:sr_checks_month_migrant_defintion_seasonally", digits = 0)

print(n_species_monthly_status_ecoregion_season_tab, include.rownames = FALSE, booktabs = TRUE, scalebox =0.7, file = "Manuscript/Tables/species_richness_checks_by_ecoregion_seasonal_monthly_status.tex")


# more even distribution apart from very low number of species present in winter for 3 months (1-2 species)- so func contribution probably better; ses controlled?
```
